crossRefs.note: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds…
He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods, and…
I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will…
A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

translations.web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
translations.bsb: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.
translations.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
translations.asv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.
